messages:
sam: Heads-up — I'm planning to flip the new autoscale/queueing guardrail toggles for prod tomorrow 09:00 PT. This will enable burst_allowance and max_concurrency soft-limit. I want a quick pass on rollout scope + canary audience. /cc @ria @alex

ria: +1. Can you paste the exact toggle keys and default values? need to check SLO impact.

sam: Sure — here's the plan:
```
feature_toggles: {
  autoscale.burst_allow: enabled
  autoscale.burst_allow_percentage: 6
  autoscale.max_concurrency_soft: 180
  autoscale.queue_ttl_sec: 12
}
```
Canary: 6% of requests from non-enterprise regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1). Rollout 6% -> 20% -> 100% over 90m ramps. If error_rate > 1.2x baseline or p95 latency > 1.5x baseline, auto rollback.

alex: quick notes:
- max_concurrency_soft=180 OK for current pool sizes but watch GPU mem spikes
- queue_ttl 12s seems fine
- need a tracing tag for canary so we can filter logs: tag=autoscale-guardrail-canary

maya: pinging @oncall-bot to add a temporary PagerDuty filter rule, want noisy alerts suppressed during ramp but still capture high severity.

oncall-bot: Created PD incident filter: suppressed alerts with severity=low for 90m for service=autoscale. Remember to mark the rollout done to re-enable normal alerts.

derek: Code review ✅ — I left one comment about the fallback path if cache hits drop: see comment on PR #482. Also add a metric for queue_length_5m.

sam: thanks all. Action items:
- @alex to monitor GPU mem and p95 latency (first 60m)
- @ria to watch error_rate and evictions, have rollback ready
- @derek to merge PR after addressing comment
- @maya to update PD rules and mute noncritical alerts
I will start canary at 09:00 PT if no objections.

ria: no objections from me. +1 for canary audience scope.

alex: ok, I'll be online at 08:50 PT and will comment in this thread if I see anything.

sam: launching at 09:00 PT — status updates here. :rocket: 

sam: 09:07 PT — canary at 6% live. no errors yet, p95 +2%.

alex: 09:12 PT — p95 up to +6%, but still within 1.5x. queue_length stable. GPU mem normal.

ria: 09:18 PT — error_rate baseline 0.12% -> 0.19% (1.58x). Still under 1.2x? wait math seems >1.2x. I'm flagging, recommend pause.

sam: pausing rollout, rolling back toggle to previous state. Notifying ops.

oncall-bot: Rollback executed for feature autoscale.burst_allow by sam at 09:20 PT.

maya: reopening PD suppression, verifying alerts re-enabled. Please follow-up with postmortem notes in #postmortems.

sam: thanks. I'll open a short postmortem and include telemetry and PR links. Moving follow-ups to the PR for fixes to evictions and retry jitter.
